name: Verity Hiltcap
description: Watch the opponent's feet and shoulders for the moment a cut ends and the guard has not yet returned.

name: Gust Nick
description: Step onto the dead side of a finished cut and set the point on the opponent's exposed ribs.

name: Murk Cutedge
description: Beat the incoming blade aside with a short flat stroke and hold the cover for the answer to follow.

name: Poketorment
description: Stab in the same breath as a parry so the answer lands before the opponent has finished his attack.

name: Glint Stabtip
description: Drive a qi-backed stab through the gap that opens as the opponent draws back his sword arm.

name: Chime Handguard
description: Jolt the opponent's blade with a sharp qi-laden beat that spoils the timing of his next cut.

name: Transfixing Gore
description: Meet a committed thrust by stepping offline and impale the opponent's torso with a heavy qi pulse in the point.

name: Resilient Facet Hiltcap
description: Ride a cut down the blade with a turn of the wrist and return its force as a stab at the same arm.

name: Waning Thumbrest
description: Read where rings overlap and straps cross on the opponent's armor to pick the thinnest line for the point.

name: Glintnick
description: Prick the armpit gap as the opponent raises his sword arm to cut.

name: Needling Sting
description: Aim a narrow stab through the eye slit of a helm when the head is turned toward the point.

name: Annealed Cutedge
description: Slide an enemy's blade along the flat of a plate edge and let it ring off without biting.

name: Facet Poke
description: Wedge the point into the joint between plates at the knee or elbow and lever it deeper with qi.

name: Crippling Nick
description: Hook the edge under an armor strap and cut it so the plate hangs loose and slows the wearer.

name: Might Hiltcap
description: Rap the pommel on a helm rim with qi in the wrist to jar the wearer's head and blur his sight.

name: Gorethrash
description: Drive a concentrated qi thrust into a seam and split the layers of mail and padding beneath.

name: Tipassault
description: Pierce through the ring collar at the throat in one hard stab that no stiffened mail can stop.

name: Granite Hiltcap
description: Hold the blade pressed against the sternum with the point high so the opponent cannot swing inside the guard.

name: Pokethrash
description: Pump the blade forward in tiny strokes from the elbow with the bodies pressed together.

name: Gyve Broadleaf
description: Seize the opponent's collar with the off hand and pull him onto the point.

name: Skinning Dig
description: Slash across the inner thigh with a short flick when the bodies are too close for the point.

name: Staggering Thumbrest
description: Stamp on the opponent's lead foot to fix him in place while the blade works at his belly.

name: Manacling Stubblade
description: Lock a hip against the opponent's thigh and twist with qi through the legs to turn him off balance.

name: Harpooning Gore
description: Reach behind the opponent's guard arm with a bent wrist and stab into the ribs from the inside.

name: Drubbing Hiltcap
description: Drive the pommel upward into the opponent's chin with a burst of qi behind the shoulder.

name: Stabthrash
description: Hold the opponent close and impale him in a single hard stab with qi gathered at the point of contact.

name: Tiered Handguard
description: Throw the opponent over the hip and finish with a downward stab as he lands on his back.

name: Aura Pointcap
description: Let the qi field around the body register an approaching blade before the eyes can follow it.

name: Nimbus Sting
description: Send the stab out on a single breath with the field gathering at the point.

name: Aura Cutedge
description: Parry using the field's warning so the blade arrives at the cut a moment before it does.

name: Nimbus Poke
description: Step so near that the opponent's field and the swordsman's field overlap and the blades cannot swing.

name: Needling Dig
description: Let the field guide the point through a narrow gap in the opponent's guard without watching the blade.

name: Enduring Stubblade
description: Hold a thin field about the body so that grazing cuts slide away without drawing blood.

name: Aura Stabtip
description: Stab with the field wrapped about the blade so the point carries qi through light armor.

name: Quelling Shortspine
description: Press the field into the opponent's and dull his edge as the two circles touch.

name: Glancing Nick
description: Slip out of the opponent's field along the edge and appear on the open flank with the point raised.

name: Nickbarrage
description: Gather the whole breath into a single stab at close range that drives the point through leather and bone.

name: Mantled Broadleaf
description: Wrap the whole body and blade in a dense field to hold against a flurry of close cuts.

name: Nickthrash
description: Open the chain with a light prick at the guard hand to draw the first parry.

name: Digleap
description: Step into the second strike while the opponent is still parrying the first.

name: Hardened Handguard
description: Roll the wrist around the opponent's parry to bring the point back onto the line.

name: Nova Stab
description: Close the chain with a deep stab at the spot the earlier strikes have drawn the guard from.

name: Staunch Cutedge
description: Hold a poised stance between chain links ready to start again or defend at once.

name: Reverie Poke
description: Beat the blade and withdraw as if to end the chain so the opponent relaxes his guard too soon.

name: Invigorating Knobgrip
description: Let qi pass unbroken from one stab to the next so each strike lands with the full force of the whole chain.

name: Compounding Stab
description: Turn the parry directly into a thrust without lifting the blade so the opponent has no gap to reset.

name: Lambasting Stubblade
description: Pour out a steady rain of short stabs and beats that forces the opponent onto the defensive.

name: Funneling Dig
description: Land seven separate stabs at seven separate spots in a single unbroken motion as qi carries them on.

name: Successive Hour Stabtip
description: Close an extended chain with one final heavy stab that gathers every earlier strike's momentum into the point.

name: Charter Thumbrest
description: Trace a pattern of stabs along the opponent's meridian lines to disrupt his qi circulation for a short span.

name: Unbroken Stubblade
description: Set the short sword forward and the off-hand shield or second blade across the body in matching guards.

name: Stubtorment
description: Beat with the off hand and thrust with the short sword on the very next beat.

name: Glancing Knobgrip
description: Step on the opposite foot to the opponent so the two stances mirror and neither has an angle.

name: Immovable Cutedge
description: Catch the opponent's cut on the off-hand blade while the short sword stays free to strike.

name: Tempered Stabtip
description: Stab with both blades along two lines at once so a single parry cannot cover both thrusts.

name: Compressing Knobgrip
description: Trap the opponent's blade in a scissor of the two weapons and hold it with matched qi.

name: Equipoise Thumbrest
description: Meet a heavy cut with both blades and equal qi in each so the force is split and turned.

name: Severing Nick
description: Cross both blades through the opponent's guard in a shearing cut that carries qi along both edges.

name: Alternating Poke
description: Rotate the two blades through a looped pattern of parry and strike that never leaves the body uncovered.

name: Weighty Cutedge
description: Fix the gaze on the opponent's throat and shoulder and judge the instant to drop in.

name: Stabspurt
description: Step up onto a raised footing from which a downward stab will have more weight.

name: Steadfast Thumbrest
description: Hold a coiled crouch with the blade behind the shoulder ready to drop in at once.

name: Might Stab
description: Clamp the grip like a hawk's foot and drive the point down with the whole arm.

name: Gust Knobgrip
description: Beat aside a cut with a sweeping motion of the blade like the stroke of a wing.

name: Nova Gore
description: Drop from a height onto the opponent with a straight downward stab with qi at the tip.

name: Soaring Poke
description: Rush in with a swift stab and rebound off the contact up and back out of reach.

name: Scything Cutedge
description: Slash across the opponent's guard arm with a long sweeping qi-laden cut at the end of the dive.

name: Gorebarrage
description: Fall onto the opponent from a height with the whole body behind a single qi-backed stab.

name: Careening Stabtip
description: Glide out of the stoop's finish in a long arc that lands back in guard beyond the opponent's reach.

name: Aegis Shortspine
description: Stand loose and low with the weight settled like water in a basin ready to flow in any direction.

name: Torrent Dig
description: Step with the opponent's motion rather than against it and let the blade follow his arm.

name: Thumbcloak
description: Turn the blade in a small circle that carries the opponent's cut around and past the body.

name: Tempered Dig
description: Touch the opponent's blade lightly and send a ripple of motion through to a stab at his wrist.

name: Flux Stab
description: Slip along the opponent's arm like a current along a bank and stab where the bank gives way.

name: Ponderous Thumbrest
description: Drag the opponent's blade down with a slow persistent pressure that saps his arm and slows his cuts.

name: Stubassault
description: Gather the opponent's own force into a swell and release it through a stab that breaks his guard.

name: Nickcanter
description: Curve around the opponent's attack in a long bend and arrive on his flank with the point already set.

name: Regal Stubblade
description: Hold the body track and qi track in a single stance with the blade at the point of their meeting.

name: Digbarrage
description: Drive the thrust along a straight track with the qi running in an even line alongside it.

name: Thumbspurt
description: Step twice in matched rhythm along two parallel lines to close without a single wasted motion.

name: Unshaken Cutedge
description: Turn the blade and the body together in two matched pivots so a cut falls into empty air.

name: Iron Poke
description: Flick the wrist in answer to the opponent's own so that the cut meets his before it has formed.

name: Meridian Shortspine
description: Read the opponent's body motion and qi flow together and follow both with the point.

name: Pokeassault
description: Cross the body track over the qi track at the end of the thrust for a sudden burst at the point.

name: Mantled Thumbrest
description: Weave a guard of matched steel and qi that holds without gaps against cuts from either side.

name: Mayhem Handguard
description: Reverse the opponent's rhythm by beating off the offbeat so he loses his own timing.

name: Harrowing Nova Stabtip
description: Send the body and qi tracks into one point and impale the target with the combined drive.

name: Staunch Hiltcap
description: Recover to guard along both tracks at once so that a counter finds no opening on either.

name: Implacable Knobgrip
description: Stand with the point turned to the wind and the weight forward as if leaning into a steady gale.

name: Gust Pointcap
description: Step in on a gust of wind so that the approach is hidden by the rush of air.

name: Pokebarrage
description: Stab along the sworn line without wavering once the point has committed to the target.

name: Gust Stubblade
description: Turn aside a cut with a soft stroke of the blade like a breeze shifting a leaf.

name: Tipsprint
description: Slide over open ground low and fast with no cover to hide the approach.

name: Burly Handguard
description: Feel the draught on the skin to find where the opponent's movement stirs the air.

name: Racing Dig
description: Ride an updraft into a long lunge that ends in a stab at the opponent's chest.

name: Unflinching Cutedge
description: Meet a cut with an edge held to its oath and turn it aside with firm unwavering qi.

name: Splitting Dig
description: Cut across the line of the wind so the blade swings faster and lands before the opponent can turn.

name: Ravaging Gore
description: Rain short stabs in the rhythm of a rising wind until the opponent can no longer raise his guard.

name: Stingassault
description: Compress the wind about the point and drive it through the target in a single narrow stab.

name: Gorejaunt
description: Let the wind carry the body out of a cut's path and set it down inside the opponent's reach.

name: Granite Broadleaf
description: Plant the feet along a cliff lip with the weight back from the drop and the blade steady.

name: Digthrash
description: Stride across flat ground and stab on the last step with the weight behind the point.

name: Nickjaunt
description: Step along the cliff edge to push the opponent toward the drop with the blade held low.

name: Tipplating
description: Parry with the wind at the back so the blade has the extra push of the air behind it.

name: Chime Broadleaf
description: Feel through the soles for loose stones and slopes that could ruin the next step or stab.

name: Facet Gore
description: Circle to the sheltered side of the opponent where the wind cannot carry the blow away and stab.

name: Thorn Stabtip
description: Pin the opponent's blade and drive him back toward the drop by main force and qi.

name: Silt Dig
description: Slip through the gap between two gusts and arrive at the opponent's side before he has turned.

name: Goreassault
description: Push the opponent against a rock face and drive a qi-heavy stab that has nowhere to give.

name: Annealed Pointcap
description: Hold a rooted stance at the edge as qi sinks into the legs and no push can move the body.

name: Remnant Pointcap
description: Fix the bearing to the opponent's centre and hold it through every shift of his stance.

name: Auradig
description: Step along the held bearing so the point never loses the line to the opponent's centre.

name: Might Sting
description: Thrust along the locked bearing in a single clean line that no feint can pull aside.

name: Unflinching Broadleaf
description: Keep the point steady on the bearing and refuse every feint until the real cut comes.

name: Suppressing Hiltcap
description: Hold the line so firmly that the opponent cannot step across it without taking the point.

name: Glint Dig
description: Stab along the bearing with qi poured into the held line until the point lands on its mark.

name: Blurring Nick
description: Correct a drifting bearing with a small precise step so the stab arrives true on the line.

name: Digassault
description: Hold the bearing against everything and impale the opponent with a single patient qi-heavy stab.

name: Implacable Handguard
description: Hold the blade steady and let the bearing turn aside each cut that tries to cross the line.

name: Enduring Cutedge
description: Stand with the weight on the balls of the feet and the point forward with no thought of retreat.

name: Thumbcanter
description: Rush forward in three quick paces timed to the swell of the wind.

name: Nicktorment
description: Stab behind the blur of a gust of dust or leaves so the point arrives unseen.

name: Unyielding Knobgrip
description: Meet a blow with the edge square and hold the oath not to give ground.

name: Gust Dig
description: Close the gap between two bodies in a single gust-powered stride and arrive with the point leading.

name: Regal Cutedge
description: Parry with qi fixed to the oath so firmly that the opponent's blade cannot break through.

name: Stabbarrage
description: Drive the stab out on a rising wind so the point pierces beyond what the arm alone could manage.

name: Regal Handguard
description: Hold the guard with nothing behind and let qi in the legs root the body against any charge.
